segments.text: This demo shows Meridian semantic search over a long product video.
First we upload a one-hour recording from a customer onboarding call.
The pipeline extracts audio, builds a transcript, and constructs a hierarchy tree.
Type a natural language question in the search box.
Results list grounded answers with citation chips.
Each citation includes a start and end timestamp.
Clicking a citation seeks the player to that timestamp automatically.
You can also filter results by chapter using the hierarchy tree.
Administrators can export the cited answer as a shareable clip.
Repeat queries against the same video hit the multi-tier cache.
That keeps demos snappy without re-embedding the full transcript.
We also show a cost estimate panel so teams can forecast spend.
Finally the UI highlights which provider answered the question.
